request_text_excerpt: Subject: CPRA 25-1003 — Outstanding Communications, Search Records, and Objection to Consolidation To the City of Berkeley: On June 13, 2025, the City closed request 25-1003 and represented that all responsive materials would be provided under 24-773. My original request expressly included emails, text messages, memoranda, internal communications, attachments, drafts, and notes referencing Joey Mitchell, 1612 Delaware Street, or complaints, citations, or issues involving that property.
